title: QA Engineer
description:
This is a remote position.
We are seeking a dedicated and talented QA Engineer with 5+ years experience to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will possess a solid background in software testing, with a focus on automated testing frameworks and tools. Your expertise in Pytest, API testing, performance testing, Cypress, and Playwright will play a crucial role in maintaining and enhancing the quality of our software products. ​
Key Responsibilities:​

• Design, develop, and execute automated tests using Pytest for backend testing and Cypress/Playwright for frontend testing.

• Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for backend services using industry-standard tools and frameworks.

• Conduct API testing to ensure high-quality integration and robustness of system interactions.

• Develop and maintain performance testing suites to ensure the scalability and responsiveness of applications.

• Collaborate with development teams to identify system requirements and incorporate quality assurance measures from the initial stages of development.

• Analyze test results, report on test execution, and track defects to ensure timely resolution.

• Enhance and maintain the automation framework to support continuous integration and continuous deployment processes.

• Participate in code reviews and design discussions to ensure best practices and high-quality standards in test script development.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and advancements in software testing.

Requirements
Required Skills and Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

• 3-4 years of experience in QA testing with a strong focus on automation in API

• At Least 2 years of experience in Cypress/Playwright

• Proficient with Pytest and scripting in Python.

• Experienced in API testing and using tools such as Postman or similar.

• Experience with database testing, including SQL and familiarity with database technologies (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

• Perform thorough regression testing and ensure continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices are followed.

• Hands-on experience with performance testing tools and methodologies.

• Proficient with modern frontend testing frameworks such as Cypress and Playwright.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD processes and tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Desirable Skills:

• Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes.

• Familiarity with cloud services (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their management APIs.

• Prior experience in an Agile development environment.

title: Senior SEO Strategy Lead (SEO, AEO, GEO)
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Organic search is one of Airbnb's largest and most efficient acquisition channels, and the rise of AI answer engines is reshaping how travelers discover places to stay, things to do, and trusted Hosts. This role sits at the intersection of growth marketing, content strategy, and emerging AI search behavior, partnering closely with product, engineering, content, and data science teams to make Airbnb the trusted source that search engines and AI models cite.

 

The Difference You Will Make

As Senior Growth Marketing Lead, SEO, AEO, GEO, you will own the strategy and day-to-day execution for how Airbnb shows up in Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and the assistants that come next. You are an execution-focused operator with a career built in SEO - you write your own SQL, size opportunities from raw data, and ship. Success in this role means measurable gains in organic visibility, rankings, AI citations, traffic, bookings, and downstream conversion, along with a measurement framework that proves the business value of organic channels. This is a chance to define what AEO and GEO mean for Airbnb and build the playbook others follow.

 

A Typical Day

• Own the organic growth strategy and content roadmap across SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) - covering technical SEO, content, on-site experience, and visibility in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity.

• Manage internal content strategy for these acquisition channels: set priorities, briefs, templates, and quality standards for content and landing pages that drive organic and AI-referred traffic.

• Run the channel hands-on - pull and analyze your own data in SQL, size opportunities, prioritize by impact, and drive launches and experiments from backlog to measured result.

• Lead cross-functional relationships with product and engineering teams, embedding SEO and AEO best practices into web properties, app surfaces, and structured data.

• Improve how well AI models understand Airbnb's listings, product, and policies so they represent Airbnb accurately and cite it as a source.

• Build and evolve the measurement framework for SEO, AEO, and GEO - attribution models, leading and lagging indicators, dashboards, and revenue impact - including the ability to demonstrate the value of work that's difficult to attribute, such as preventive technical work or emerging AI channels.

• Establish Airbnb's point of view on how AI-generated answers are reshaping travel discovery, and translate complex technical concepts into clear business narratives for senior leaders.

Your Expertise

• 10+ years of experience in SEO, including 2+ years in a senior/leadership capacity engaging with executives.

• Strong SQL skills, writing your own queries to analyze crawl, log, search console, and conversion data without relying on analysts for core questions.

• Proven track record of shipping SEO programs at scale and driving significant organic growth, from prioritization through launch and measurement.

• Expertise in both technical SEO and content strategy, including site architecture, structured data, indexation, and content quality.

• Working knowledge of how AI-powered search and answer engines operate (LLM-based retrieval, citation behavior, entity recognition), with a clear point of view on how to optimize for them.

• Strong analytical foundation, comfortable with attribution challenges and building measurement frameworks that quantify the business impact of organic channels.

title: Staff Product Manager, Agent Connectivity
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We're at an inflection point. We started with core durable execution and are now evolving with the world as it transitions to AI. What it takes to get from where we are today to a world where Temporal underpins all software - including and especially agents - is going to be different. It will require unprecedented speed, iteration, market and customer focus, and invention.

As an Agent Connectivity PM, you’ll help the world makes its transition to AI on Temporal. Without any effort, the market has already identified Temporal as a good substrate for agent workloads. But what makes agents powerful is connecting them to services and data. We are in the infancy of building out our connectivity layer, called Nexus, which has been the brainchild of our founder, Maxim, for many years. We now need to realize the full vision of Nexus by continuing to build out foundational capabilities like xyz and importantly, building agent-specific features and integrations, e.g., MCP connector, tool registry. You’ll identify the highest leverage areas for us to invest, and work closely with the founder/CTO and engineering team to get them to market.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Deeply understand problems faced by agent builders and identify opportunities where our products can make building agents faster, more intuitive, more reliable, and more powerful.

- Define and build what’s next for Temporal. Own strategy and roadmap for agent connectivity. Turn ambiguous signals into clear product theses. How should we prioritize new capabilities like identity propagation or rate limits? How do we bootstrap an ecosystem of connectors?

- Perform up-front discovery and translate customer, field, and open-source community signals into small tweaks, brand new abstractions, or platform bets.

- Help engineers and designers deeply understand user needs, empowering them to make great product decisions.

- Craft messaging around upcoming features that resonates with users.

- Enable sales and marketing teams to effectively communicate with and win customers.

- Strong technical depth. Ability to reason about distributed systems, workflow orchestration, service-to-service communication, APIs, SDKs, identity, and authorization.

- Developer-platform experience. Experience with infrastructure, platforms, integrations, APIs, SDKs, service mesh, API gateways, or cloud developer products.

You’ll build new things with a massive tailwind behind you: a proven technology, a large and growing customer base, and a market moving toward problems Temporal is uniquely equipped to solve. The opportunity is to turn that momentum into what comes next-not simply scale what already works. You’ll be expected to move fast, work across boundaries, and do what it takes to make it happen.

WHO YOU ARE

- You're ambitious. You want to win big. You don’t need someone else to set the pace. You get impatient when good ideas stay in slide decks, Slack, or meetings.

- You're an owner. You are accountable to results over the process. You’re less focused on your swim lane and more focused on making the company successful. You have exceptional product and operational judgement.

- You're resilient. Building at a high-growth company in 2026 is not for the faint of heart. You see the challenges and change as not just normal, but actually desirable.

- You want to grow, and help others grow. You self-reflect often. You give feedback, and you seek it out. You have shameless curiosity and a propensity to question things deeply.

- You prioritize the customer above all else. You want to understand our users' world and prioritize solving their problems above everything else.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- You have 8+ years of product management experience

- You have technical depth, with experience working on platform, infrastructure, developer tools, or other technical products

- You have worked at a startup, high-growth company or in a similarly intense and ambiguous environment

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

- Nexus

title: Consultant - Child Rights
description:
ChildFund Australia is a member of the ChildFund Alliance - a global network of 10 organisations which assists almost 36 million children and their families in 66 countries. ChildFund Australia directly manages and implements programs with a range of local partners in Cambodia, Myanmar, Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste, Vietnam, and other Pacific nations, and manages projects delivered by partner organisations throughout Asia, Africa, and the Americas.
Purpose
ChildFund seeks to strengthen its existing participation approach so that stakeholders can engage with, validate, challenge, and enrich the findings of Child Rights Situation Analyses, helping to identify priority issues, emerging trends, evidence gaps, and opportunities for action. The resulting insights will inform organisational strategy, country planning, program portfolios, advocacy priorities, and investment decisions, ensuring that these are grounded not only in published evidence but also in the perspectives and experiences of children and communities themselves.
This assignment will develop practical guidelines, tools, and supporting resources that enable this process to be undertaken consistently across country contexts. The approach should be low burden, repeatable, and designed to leverage existing community engagement structures wherever possible, recognising the capacity constraints facing Country Offices and partners. It should also promote accountability by establishing clear mechanisms for reporting back on how participant feedback influenced findings, priorities, and subsequent decisions.
The consultant will also provide technical advice on the role of Youth Voice in ChildFund’s strategy development and broader strategic decision-making, including its evolving purpose, Terms of Reference, engagement processes and feedback mechanisms.
The consultancy period is 20 days spread across 3 months.
Interested consultants should submit an expression of interest including: a technical proposal (max. 3 pages) outlining understanding of the assignment, proposed search strategy and sources, and workplan; a financial proposal/fee schedule in USD; a curriculum vitae including at least two references from similar assignments; and a sample of previous, similar written work.
ChildFund Australia believes in a global community where children are safe and can reach their full potential. We take extensive steps to safeguard children in any work done by our people, i.e., our staff, volunteers and interns, supporters, partners, board members, ambassadors and suppliers. We strive to keep children safe through child safe practices, and rigorously ensure we prevent, oppose, and combat all exploitation and abuse of children and vulnerable people. As part of this commitment, all people working with us will undergo relevant background checks before joining ChildFund Australia .
At ChildFund Australia , all staff must remain alert and responsive to any child safeguarding or sexual exploitation, abuse, or harassment (SEAH) risks. Staff will acquire the knowledge and skills needed to understand our Child Safeguarding and PSEAH policies & procedures, promote strong safeguarding practices, and conduct themselves consistent with these policies.
In line with our values, diversity of people and ideas is critical to our work and our success at ChildFund Australia . We strive for a team culture that is welcoming, inclusive, and supportive. ChildFund is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and strongly encourages people from all backgrounds, abilities, and identities to apply

title: Senior Database Administrator (Freelancer)
description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores ' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60-70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migrations don't fail at conversion. They fail at go-live DMS latency nobody diagnosed, autovacuum behavior nobody tuned, privilege mappings nobody tested, incidents nobody owns at 2 a.m. This role sits inside our Application & Database Modernization pillar and exists to make sure that doesn't happen.
As our Senior Database Administrator, you'll run the Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL environments in an active Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration program from cluster design through DMS replication through post-go-live stabilization. Aedeon handles the repeatable conversion and validation work; you own what agents can't: production judgment. When replication lags, when a workload misbehaves after cutover, when an incident escalates past L2, you're the person who resolves it and can explain why it happened.
This is a freelance engagement, remote, working as the L3 escalation point on production systems that real businesses run on.
What you will do?

• Design, set up, configure, and manage Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL clusters.

• Configure parameters, maintenance windows, monitoring, and scaling strategies.

• Keep the environments highly available, fault tolerant, and operationally ready - before go-live, not after.

• Map users, roles, and privileges from Oracle to PostgreSQL.

• Implement least-privilege access, role hierarchies, and security best practices, and support audit and compliance requirements.

• Configure, run, monitor, and optimize AWS DMS tasks (Full Load and CDC).

• Troubleshoot DMS latency, data mismatches, and performance issues, and tune DMS settings for large-volume, high-throughput workloads.

• Tune server and database performance - CPU, memory, I/O, connections - plus PostgreSQL parameters, autovacuum, indexing, and query behavior.

• Find performance bottlenecks before the customer does, and resolve them.

• Design and implement backup and restore strategies; define and test DR and failover procedures; support cross-region replication and recovery drills.

• Lead post-go-live stabilization: monitor production workloads, resolve incidents, and act as the L3 escalation point for database-related production issues.

• Deliver operational documentation and handover support, so what you stabilized stays stable after you.

What are we looking for?

• 5+ years of experience administering Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL.

• Proven expertise supporting Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migrations.

• Hands-on experience with AWS DMS.

• Advanced PostgreSQL performance tuning and troubleshooting skills.

• Strong knowledge of backup, restore, and DR planning in AWS.

• Experience with AWS monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Performance Insights).

• Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis abilities.

• Experience working in production and post-go-live environments.

• The ability to work independently as an L3 escalation engineer.

• Clear communication and documentation skills.

You will be preferred if

• Familiarity with automation and configuration management tools, such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet

• Familiarity with IAAC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation

• Familiarity with CI/CD implementation tools like Liquibase/Flyway

• AWS Certified Database - Specialty

• AWS Certified Solutions Architect

How we work?
We refactor legacy databases to cloud-native AWS on a committed date, with Mactores car

You will lead our clients through the organisational and operational changes needed to establish a shared AI platform. Some might be ordering for the first time. Others have been buying from us for years. Some need an occasional reminder or a well-timed offer, while others represent significant opportunities that deserve a much more personalized approach.

Today, we reach these customers through emails, SMS, automated journeys, promotional campaigns, gifting programs, and direct outreach. title: Senior Google Ads Buyer, DTC eCommerce
description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
Requirements
What the job looks like

•
Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

•
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

•
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

•
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

•
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

•
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. title: Manager, Developer Advocacy (EMEA)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for someone to run Developer Advocacy in EMEA. You’ll get to shape how developers across the region first find Temporal, and you’ll also see it through to the other end, helping our biggest customers build serious systems on it.

You’ll manage a team of advocates, but this isn’t a desk job. You’ll still give talks, run workshops, write code, and sit down with customers yourself. If it’s been a while since you built a demo from scratch, this probably isn’t the right fit.

EMEA covers a lot of ground. The UK, Germany, France, the Netherlands, and the Nordics have big developer communities and some of our largest customers.

You’ll spend a lot of time with our Marketing department on events and community, and with Sales, Solutions Architects, and Developer Success on customer accounts. Good relationships with all of them are your key to success.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Hire, coach, and support a team of Developer Advocates spread across the region. Set priorities, then trust them to adapt to their own markets and audiences.

- Decide how the team splits its time between community and customer work. Sort incoming customer requests by deal size, stage, and strategic value, and make the tough calls when there’s more demand than people, without letting community work get pushed aside.

- Work with Marketing to plan where we show up in EMEA: which conferences to speak at and which meetups to start or support.

- Create and localize content that developers in the region will use, like talks, tutorials, blog posts, videos, sample apps, and livestreams.

- Find the people in local communities who care about the problems Temporal solves and help them lead, contribute to open source, and spread the word.

- Track whether it’s working: are more developers signing up, trying Temporal, and sticking around?

- Own DevDays, our onsite customer engagement program, in EMEA from start to finish. Work with the Global DevDays lead to tailor each one to the customer’s use cases.

- Spot the engineers inside each account who could become champions, and make sure someone follows up with them.

- Take what you hear from developers and customers back to Docs, Education, and Product, especially around language, data residency, and what different markets need.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Experience in developer advocacy, solutions engineering, developer education, or technical community work, ideally in a developer-first company.

- People leadership experience or a clear readiness to step into it; you can coach senior individual contributors while still doing the work yourself.

- Strong hands-on technical credibility: you can build, demo, and teach, and earn the respect of senior enterprise engineers.

- An operational, execution-first mindset: you can run a repeatable program, manage intake and prioritization, and keep commitments against an SLA.

- Comfort working cross-functionally with Sales, SAs, Dev Success, Product, and Marketing, and translating technical engagement into commercial impact.

- Experience operating across a linguistically and culturally diverse region and coordinating a distributed team across multiple time zones; additional European languages are a plus.

- A genuine passion for empowering developers and creating authentic, high-trust community experiences, not sales pitches.

- Familiarity with durable execution, workflow orchestration, or distributed systems (e.g., Temporal) is a strong plus.

- Support physical infrastructure deployments, including network hardware, rack and cable management, UPS systems, and out-of-band management.

Documentation & Operational Excellence

- Maintain accurate network documentation, including network diagrams, IP addressing schemes, port mappings, ISP inventories, and operational runbooks.

title: New Media & Social Lead
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

AI-FIRST BY DEFAULT

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. If you’re energized by experimenting, adapting, and learning constantly, you’ll thrive here. Expect your day-to-day to evolve as fast as the technology does.

NEW MEDIA & SOCIAL LEAD

Building Deepgram’s social, creator, and new media program from scratch · Reports to the Head of Brand & Awareness

THE ROLE

Deepgram is a voice company, and the internet is where voice is demoed, debated, memed, and decided. We’re hiring a Brand Social Lead to build our new media, social, and creator program from the ground up, and to make Deepgram a brand people want showing up in their feed. You’re a new media strategist. Brand-first, social-first, and very online. You know that a Substack post, a creator collab, a 30-second demo clip, a sharp X thread, and a founder’s LinkedIn post are different instruments, and you know which one to play and when. You’re plugged into the creators and communities shaping AI and developer culture, and you show up with ideas nobody has tried yet.

This is a lead role with no playbook to inherit: you’ll write it. You’ll set the strategy, make creative bets, and build the systems that drive social forward, partnering closely with creative teams, communications, DevRel, product marketing, and company leadership. We’re mid-rebrand, with a new verbal and visual identity landing now, so you’ll be defining how the new Deepgram brand shows up. You’ll report to our Senior Director, Brand Marketing.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

BUILD THE PROGRAM FROM ZERO

- Define Deepgram’s social and new media strategy: which channels we own, where we show up, how we should show up there, and what we stop doing. A strategy that easily guides when to say yes, and when to say no.

- Set the baseline, the goals, and the measurement. Define what good looks like channel by channel, benchmark against competitors, and use the data to make decisions.

- Stand up the operating system: a visible calendar, intake, review, publishing, and reporting the whole company can see and trust.

- Partner with product marketing, communications, executives, and cross-company leadership to set the social calendar - understanding what to prioritize from a company perspective as well as what works best on social.

OWN EVERY CHANNEL, NATIVELY

- Lead Deepgram’s presence across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, YouT

THE ROLE

As the first Global Head of Tax, you will own tax across the group. You will lead the internal Tax function, set the group's tax strategy and risk appetite, and become the person the C-suite, the board, lenders, auditors and tax authorities deal with on tax.

This is a builder's role in a high-growth business, based in New York. You will be in the room when we choose how to enter a new country, how to price a new product and how to fund a new entity. You will also close out the historical items a young function accumulates, put in place the controls and reporting a large multinational needs, and turn a capable team into a function that scales.

This role reports to the COO / CFO and works cross-functionally with finance, treasury, product and market teams as the internal expert on tax across the group. In your first year, you will agree the target structure and ETR with the CFO and CEO, own the US return and the TP project, and put historical corrections on a single closing plan.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own Group Tax Strategy & Structure: Own the group's tax position: how our c.20 entities fit together, where profit and substance sit, and US international tax planning (GILTI, interest limitation, elections). Deliver a structure we can defend to any authority and an effective tax rate and cash-tax forecast the CFO and board can rely on, with tax budget and adviser spend under control.

- Lead US Tax: Own our US tax affairs: the consolidated federal return, state obligations across c.50 money-transmitter licences (nexus, apportionment, information reporting), our position on transaction taxes, and the relationship with the IRS and state authorities. Deliver a clean, on-time compliance record through outsourced advisors, building in-house capacity where necessary.

- Enable Market & Product Launches: Own tax for every new market we enter, product we ship and business we acquire. Give launch teams a clear tax decision early (entry vehicle, capitalisation, registrations, withholding, VAT, permanent establishment), diligence and integrate acquisitions, and make sure nothing is corrected after the fact that could have been right from day one.

- Run Compliance, Controls & Reporting: Own tax compliance and reporting across every jurisdiction and every tax: corporate tax, VAT/GST, withholding and employment taxes, provisioning under IFRS and US GAAP, and the audit relationship on tax. Keep complete visibility of obligations, close historical corrections, and build a function that would pass IPO-level scrutiny on controls, documentation, Pillar Two and the diligence pack.

- Manage Indirect & Operational Taxes: Own VAT and GST in a financial-services business, employment taxes, share schemes and global mobility, and customer tax reporting (CRS 2.0, US information reporting). Minimise VAT leakage, keep place-of-supply positions on partner agreements sound, set clear employment-tax and mobility policy as the team spreads across six hubs, and scope reporting obligations before products go live.

- Build & Lead the Tax Team: Own the in-house tax team, hiring plans and the adviser panel. Set clear goals, put advisers on defined scopes and budgets with a deliberate split between in-house and outsourced work, and integrate tax into decision-making across the business so colleagues get the input they need when they need it.

- Be the Face of Tax: Act as the main point of contact on tax for the C-suite, the board, lenders, auditors and tax authorities, giving non-specialists a clear decision with conditions, in days, and defending it later.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Senior In-House Tax Leadership: 12+ years in tax, including time as either the #1 or #2 in-house tax owner in a multinational. You have led qualified tax professionals and external advisers across time zones.

title: Global Payroll Lead
description:
About the job:
Hi, I’m Atlee and I’m the Controller at Ashby. We're hiring a Global Payroll Lead to own payroll for our fast-growing, global employee base. We pay employees across an ever-growing number of U.S. states and internationally, through a mix of local entities and employers of record (EOR). Every pay cycle has more people, more jurisdictions and more complexity than the one before.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You’ll be the company’s payroll expert and the person accountable for getting it right. You’ll run the day-to-day work yourself and also design how payroll should run as we scale. We’re looking for someone who stands out in customer service, analytical horsepower, attention to detail, independent time management and speed.

Payroll is a critical part of both the employee experience and business operations. You’ll own the full payroll cycle (semi-monthly and monthly) across all of our populations. That covers the details behind it: employee data changes, leave events, bonuses, commissions, deductions, off-cycle payments and final pay. It also covers the controls, vendors and processes that hold it all together. You’ll partner closely with Finance, People Operations, Benefits, Legal, managers, employees and external providers so that payroll is right the first time, and when it isn’t, issues get resolved quickly and the root cause gets fixed.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own recurring payroll activities across U.S., U.K., Canadian, and international EOR/contractor populations, coordinating timelines, inputs, approvals, processing, and final review.

- Collect, validate, and enter payroll changes, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, promotions, bonuses, commissions, deductions, reimbursements, leave, and return-to-work events.

- Review payroll registers and supporting reports for accuracy, reconcile discrepancies, and coordinate corrections, off-cycle payments, and retroactive adjustments.

- Partner with Finance on payroll funding, payroll accounting, reporting, reconciliations, and month-end or year-end close activities.

- Coordinate with payroll, tax, benefits, HR, and EOR vendors to resolve issues, manage escalations, and maintain exceptional service levels.

- Support payroll tax filings, notices, audits, year-end reporting, and other compliance activities in partnership with internal stakeholders and external providers.

- Serve as a trusted point of contact for employee payroll questions, explaining complex issues clearly and following through to resolution.

- Build and maintain payroll calendars, checklists, standard operating procedures, and control points that make payroll more predictable and scalable.

- Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual work, strengthen controls, and improve the connection between payroll, People systems, benefits, and Finance.

- Support projects related to payroll infrastructure, global expansion, system changes, and process improvements.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 7+ years of experience in payroll operations or payroll administration

- Direct experience supporting payroll for employees in multiple countries, including U.S. and Canadian payroll and/or international EOR or contractor populations.

- Experience in payroll for both exempt and non-exempt employee populations.

- Experience managing payroll inputs, validating payroll registers, reconciling results, and processing corrections or off-cycle payments.

- Working knowledge of payroll compliance, tax concepts, wage and hour requirements, leave-related pay, and year-end processes.

- Strong attention to detail and a consistent record of accurate execution against firm deadlines.

- Comfort working across multiple systems and vendors, with the ability to trace an issue back to its source and determine the right fix.

- Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, including the ability to audit data and explain variances.

- Excellent judgment and discretion when handling co

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) is responsible for autonomous robotics systems like the Fury unmanned fighter jet and the Barracuda family of advanced effects. The AD&S Vehicle Software team is responsible for the software running on these systems. Our software engineers collaborate with other engineering disciplines to develop software for vehicle control, networking, sensor integration, and telemetry. We are looking for engineers excited to build the foundational vehicle software stack that supports the wide range of AD&S initiatives, from early concept simulation to first flight to live operations to large scale fleet management.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead the team’s technical direction and delivery against customer milestones, and act as a technical point of contact for customers

• Drive solutions that balance end-user needs with the requirements of government customers, industry partners and Anduril teams

• Design scalable software that runs on- and off- robotic platforms, with components re-usable across Anduril product lines

• Create test and simulation fixtures that operate with both software- and hardware-in-the-loop

• Support integration events, demonstrations and test events, through to live flight test

• Own the technical content of customer deliverables such as architecture and test documentation

• Lead and mentor a multi-disciplinary engineering team across multiple sites

• Travel to co-locate with end-users and/or other teams up to 30% of the time

• BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or related field.

• 8+ years of production-grade C++ and/or Rust experience in a Linux development environment

• Experience leading a team of software engineers: setting technical direction, reviewing designs and code, and delivering against customer milestones

• Experience building software solutions involving significant amounts of data processing and analysis

• Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and established code bases

• A desire to work on critical software that has a real-world impact

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Negative Vetting 2 security clearance (NV2)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong background with focus in Physics, Mathematics, and/or Motion Planning to inform modeling & simulation (M&S) and physical systems

• Developing and testing multi-agent autonomous systems and deploying in real-world environments.

• Feature and algorithm development with an understanding of behavior trees.

• Developing software/hardware for flight systems and safety critical functionality.

• Distributed communication networks and message standards

• Knowledge of military systems and operational tactics
